purpose: Teach: 表象/場内/別館/採集/持ち出す/取り返し/備考/呼びかける

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社の表象、本気で、絶対、社員、皆、誇りに、思える、ものに、本気で、絶対、していけ、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対。
lines.en: I'm counting on you. Make sure everything we do as a company is something every single employee can be proud of. This matters.
lines.style: Steady, measured authority. Weight on the opening demand. Deliberate pacing. Ends with quiet finality — not harsh, but non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。発表会の場内、本気で、絶対、お客様、満員、本気で、感謝、しております、絶対、本当に、本気で、絶対、感謝、絶対。
lines.en: Understood. The presentation was well-attended, and we're genuinely grateful for all the customers who came. Thank you.
lines.style: Respectful, formal register. Careful articulation. Slight bow in the voice without sounding servile. Earnest gratitude underneath the courtesy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 別館の改装、本気で、絶対、進めろ、本気で、社員、利用しやすい空間、絶対、目指せ、本気で、頼んだぞ、本気、絶対。
lines.en: The annex renovation is moving forward. I want the final space to be something our staff actually wants to use. Make it comfortable.
lines.style: Clear directive paced like instructions, not lecturing. Slight warmth underneath — he cares that his team has a decent space. Professional but not cold.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場の声の採集、本気で、絶対、徹底してまいります、本気で、絶対、お客様、絶対、ご満足、本気で、感謝、絶対、本気で、絶対。
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're collecting feedback from the market carefully, and we're committed to making sure every customer leaves satisfied. We appreciate the opportunity.
lines.style: Formal, attentive delivery. Each phrase distinct and considered. The rhythm of someone taking notes mentally. Genuine respect in the closing gratitude.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 機密、本気で、絶対、社外に、持ち出すな、絶対、社員、徹底させろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Confidential information stays in-house. Make sure every employee understands that. This isn't negotiable.
lines.style: Harder edge here. Clipped pacing. The tone shifts to something more serious — not angry, but firm. Each sentence lands with weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。取り返しのつかない、本気で、絶対、事態、避けるよう、社員、皆、本気で、絶対、注意しております、絶対、本気で、感謝、絶対。
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're emphasizing the irreversible damage that can come from carelessness. All staff are being reminded. We take this seriously.
lines.style: Careful, almost cautious delivery. Acknowledges the gravity of what he's saying. Slower pace than the gratitude lines — this is about responsibility, not courtesy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 書類の備考欄、本気で、絶対、丁寧に、書け、本気で、お客様、絶対、わかりやすく、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対、本気で、絶対、本気。
lines.en: When you fill out those remarks sections, take your time. Make it clear and easy for the customer to understand. That detail matters.
lines.style: Specific instruction with underlying care. Not barking orders — guiding. Slight emphasis on the 'why' without spelling it out. Patient but expecting compliance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員に、本気で、絶対、安全対策、呼びかける活動、本気で、絶対、続けてまいります、本気で、感謝、絶対、本気で、絶対、本気。
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're continuing our safety awareness initiatives across the team, and we remain committed to that work. Thank you.
lines.style: Closing energy — slightly more relaxed than the previous answer, but still formal. The breath settles. He's wrapping up and expressing gratitude for being heard.
